name: pos-next-frontend

scripts.verify: vitest run && biome lint src tests && vue-tsc --noEmit

comment: Dependency pruning (measured, not guessed): every package above is
imported by shipped code, a config, a CSS @import or an npm script.
Removed because nothing referenced them: @pinia/testing (no test uses
manual target computation — Vite computes its own), and browserslist
(Vite depends on it; declaring it only froze a version by accident).
The old "resolutions" block was yarn-only config in an npm-only repo, so
it never applied. baseline-browser-mapping went with it: there is no
browserslist config in this package (no key, no .browserslistrc), so the
devDependency installed ~20 packages to influence nothing. If a browserslist
target ever becomes a requirement, declare the config and the package in the

@vue/test-utils lives in devDependencies: the tests import it and shipped code does not, and as a production dependency it dragged js-beautify -> editorconfig -> minimatch -> brace-expansion into npm audit --omit=dev (one high advisory on a library the PWA never ships).

fake-indexeddb lives in devDependencies for the same reason: jsdom ships no IndexedDB, so every Dexie-backed test that opens the real db died with MissingAPIError before asserting anything. tests/setupIndexedDB.js installs the polyfill for the suite only. Tests that want a table double instead (offlineStore, repositories) keep using one — a fake exercises the harness, this exercises Dexie's own transactions.
